question: What knowledge enables Viṣṇu to function as the preserver?
premises: There is a knowledge to be known.
Having known it, Viṣṇu becomes the maker of preservation.
This is addressed to the pure-smiling one.
inference: The same knowledge empowers Viṣṇu to act as the preserver.
plain_english: And, O pure-smiling one, having known which, the god Viṣṇu becomes the maker of preservation.
